subject: Do shiny/RStudio support the Selection and execCommand API's?

messages.author: 3fd19fd766bba142
messages.subject: Do shiny/RStudio support the Selection and execCommand API's?
parts:
Hi,

I am working on a small package, called rclipboard (https://github.com/sbihorel/rclipboard), which intends to provide a UI button with copy-to-clipboard functionality. This is achieved by "wrapping" the button code around the HTML5-based clipboard.js (https://www.clipboardjs.com) javascript framework. Essentially, this packages will do with clipboard.js what the zeroclipr R package (https://github.com/smbache/zeroclipr/) does with the Flash-based zeroclipboard.js framework.

clipboard.js relies upon the Selection and execCommand API's, which are supported by most modern web browsers.

Interestingly, my copy-to-clipboard button works just fine when it is included in an app deployed on a Shiny server, but it does not when the same app is run locally from RStudio. While there could be many reasons why this is the case, I wanted to start by asking whether shiny/RStudio support the Selection and execCommand API's.

Thanks for you help.

Sebastien Bihorel
